notes: Streets: EGGLESTON AV. (91', railroad siding and old canal strip inside it; west face x~440 is the edge of the sheet-125 blocks, east face x~717-753; centre taken at x~590), LOCK (60', centre x~1102-1110), E. 5TH, E. 4TH (30'), E. 3RD (no width printed, about 50 ft), FINN (40'), ELLEN (50'), KILGOUR (40'), BAUM (37' near 5th, 39' and 33' further south). The Mt. Adams & Eden Park Inclined Plane crosses Lock, Kilgour and Baum diagonally between 5th and Finn; ignored as railroad. E 5th is about 63 ft between Eggleston and Lock and 48' east of Lock (the 48' label at x~1220 and x~2525 may also be read as the 48 in. main, but it matches the measured width). E 4th does not cross between Eggleston and Lock (National Biscuit Co. buildings over its line; sheet 125 also has 4th ending at Eggleston), so Eggleston/4th (from the west) and Lock/4th (from the east) are separate T's. Ellen/Finn is an L-corner: Ellen ends at Finn and Finn ends at Ellen's west face line; recorded as T at the crossing of the two centrelines. Baum/5th: 5th ends at Baum; north of 5th the opening widens to about 75 ft (block 136 face at x~2510), so the point uses Baum's 37 ft centreline south of 5th. Kilgour continues south of 3rd (cross). Alleys: an unnamed 10' alley from 5th to the incline; a 20' strip of WOOD STEPS from Kilgour (east side has a 15-20 ft retaining wall) up to Baum, unnamed; a 12' alley printed NOT OPENED running from inside the Ellen-Kilgour block to 3rd; a 13' PRIVATE alley from 3rd north into the Kilgour block. Scale bar checked: 50 ft = 172 px.
